d_i: Image distance (negative for a virtual image)
d_i1: Image distance of the near end's image
d_i2: Image distance of the far end's image
d_o1: Object distance of the object's near end
d_o2: Object distance of the object's far end
m_1: Magnification at the object's near end
m_2: Magnification at the object's far end
theta_o: Angle the object fills at the near point
